notes:
Both passes agree on every requirement, cell, value and disposition: the three offerings selected by name (SVC_001, owner USER_004, production, ready, technology-management, critical), TMPL_004's service (weak, already SVC_001) and its new Mobile Email Access offering, four checks kept and one weak; there is no disagreement to record.
The three offering requirements add business_service = SVC_001 and owned_by = USER_004 to the benchmark's checks: the request is about the email service catalog (Enterprise Email is the only email service) and names 'the appropriate service owner' (its owner USER_004). The policy has no rule on service offerings, so every value comes from the request's words and the values the seed's offerings use.
The first sentence (assess all existing service offerings) is read-only and gives no requirement. No stay is written: the selectors are exact names and a single template id, and no listed tool updates or retires an existing offering. The acting user Karen Watkins (USER_039) has the admin role, with full access under policy section 2.
